What construction inspection actually covers

Assets in scope: structural steel frames and connections, reinforced concrete elements, pipe racks, cranes and lifting structures, foundations and anchor systems, and site-fabricated pressure piping.

Damage mechanisms that drive the inspection plan

Weld defects at connections — lack of fusion, undercut, toe cracking; fatigue at cyclically loaded details; corrosion at embedments, splash zones and coating breakdowns; concrete cover loss and reinforcement corrosion; and misalignment or distortion from erection.

Methods applied

Visual examination to a written procedure as the primary method, magnetic particle and penetrant for surface indications, ultrasonic and phased array for weld volume, radiography where access allows, plus concrete cover meters and rebound testing on reinforced elements.

Governing codes and standards

AWS D1.1 for structural steel welding, ASME B31.3 for process piping on industrial sites, ASME Section IX for welder qualification, ACI standards for concrete, and the project inspection and test plan which usually governs hold points more strictly than any code.

What makes this sector different

On construction projects the quality record is what gets audited rather than the programme — welder qualification continuity, NDT results tied to specific joints and drawings, material traceability by heat number, and hold-point evidence signed by the party the ITP names.

The San Francisco asset base

The San Francisco Bay Area hosts Chevron's corporate headquarters in San Ramon, Chevron Richmond Refinery (245,000 bpd), Phillips 66 Rodeo (now being converted to renewable diesel), Marathon Martinez (the largest US renewable-fuels conversion project), and Valero Benicia. The transition from petroleum to renewable diesel — at Marathon Martinez (48,000 bpd) and Phillips 66 Rodeo (50,000 bpd) — requires extensive pressure-equipment re-qualification under new feedstock conditions. CARB low-carbon-fuel standards, BAAQMD rule 12-16 refinery emission limits, and California AB 1647 inspection requirements drive systematic digital twin adoption.

How the work is controlled

Every examination carries its own evidence chain: the technician's certification for the method and level under ASNT SNT-TC-1A or ISO 9712, current on the day of inspection; the calibration status of instruments, probes, wedges and reference blocks, traceable under ISO 17025; and the revision of the procedure and technique sheet in force at the time. An ASNT NDT Level III reviews and signs the final disposition. That bundle is what a client or accreditation audit examines, and it is recorded as the work happens rather than assembled afterwards.
